newsitem.title: BRAZIL: SOCCER-ROMARIO MUST RETURN TO VALENCIA.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-ROMARIO MUST RETURN TO VALENCIA.

text.p: Romario will return to Valencia next month despite Brazilian club Flamengo's efforts to keep him.
"All I know is that the president of Valencia has said he must be in Spain by July 25. That is that," Flamengo president Kleber Leite said on Friday.
Brazilian international Romario has made no secret of his desire to remain in his beloved hometown Rio. But attempts by Flamengo to persuade Valencia to extend the loan period have failed.
"There's nothing more we can do," Leite said.
Romario signed for Valencia from Flamengo last year but spent less than three months at the Spanish club after repeatedly clashing with coach Luis Aragones.
Romario flourished on his return to Brazil and regained his place in the national side after an absence of two years.
